svg.title: Cohort B facet plates — Ways 12–20 (private interior)

symbol.title: Way 12 plate — shoulder mass turned away, numeral exiled right
Way 13 plate — bared vermilion blades, one pointing back
Way 14 plate — dated procession marching toward the numeral
Way 15 plate — left half of the father/son hinge shard
Way 16 plate — right half of the father/son hinge shard
Way 18 plate — cracked vessel spilling off the plate edge
Way 19 plate — thirty-six witness tiles in flanking banks
Way 20 plate — a held tear answered by a smaller one
